senses.sense_definition: A condition or requirement that is specified or demanded as part of an agreement.

examples.text: The only <w>stipulation</w> in the agreement was that the work must be finished by Friday.
They signed the contract without reading every single <w>stipulation</w> carefully.

senses.sense_definition: The act of making an agreement or specifying terms.

examples.text: The formal <w>stipulation</w> of rules took longer than the committee had anticipated.
Both parties concluded the treaty through careful discussion and mutual <w>stipulation</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The objective or required goal to be met in a chess problem.

examples.text: The <w>stipulation</w> for this puzzle requires White to deliver checkmate in three moves.
He struggled to solve the composition because the <w>stipulation</w> was unusually complex.

senses.sense_definition: The arrangement or structural characteristics of stipules in a plant.

examples.text: Botanists examined the distinctive <w>stipulation</w> on the newly discovered flowering plant.
The unusual <w>stipulation</w> of the leaves helps distinguish this species from related ones.
